description: Effluent and seawater sampling data from wastewater treatment plant outfalls (NESP MaC 2.4) is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Australian Ocean Data Network. This project determined the ecological effect of coastal wastewater treatment plant (WWTP) outfalls in two different coastal settings. Treated effluent, seawater, and marine sediments were collected from two WWTP outfalls located in South Australia (Glenelg & St Kilda). This is a shallow and retentive receiving environment and may accumulate effluent contaminants. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Australian Ocean Data Network. Its tags are Antimicrobials, Microplastics, National Environmental Science Program (NESP) Marine and Coastal Hub, PFAS. It offers 7 resource(s) in html, png, xlsx. The portal shows 2026-08-19 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
